description:
Add the eleven follow-on selector family objects and the polynomial interpolation field to the versioned tuning profile schema, with no selector-site change.

## Background

The follow-on selector migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §2 fixes the two field kinds and the mechanism rule with four structural read-pattern obligations, §3 gives every field its name, range, default-naming constant, read site and mechanism, §4 names the route reporter and test obligation per family, and §5.3 states the ratified amortisation screening rule and the behaviour-preservation argument (defaults name the in-source constants; observable behaviour unchanged when no profile is installed). Design §3 (all subsections) and §3.13 enumerate the families, fields, ranges, and loader consequences.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The tuning-profile loader carries the eleven new family objects and the added polynomial field with validating constructors, per-field admissible ranges as design §3 derives them, closed-vocabulary family and field variants, and CONSERVATIVE entries defined by naming each in-source constant.
- [hard] REQ-02: The regenerated conservative.json round-trips, the committed calibrated profile still loads with every new field resolving to its conservative default, and unknown-key rejection is unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: No selector read site changes and no visibility widens beyond what CONSERVATIVE's constant-naming needs; the default build's behaviour is unchanged by construction.
title: Extend the tuning schema with the follow-on selector families
